the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: choose a cardinal kappa dominating the index sets of an affine cover of U and of affine covers of the pairwise intersections and of the s-t fibres; for a family of small subsets S_i of M_i close it up under the finite-expression operators S(i,j,k,m) drawn from the alpha-descent isomorphisms on the W_ijk and the intersection opens; after omega many steps the generated submodules N_i satisfy the matching conditions N_i x A_ijk = N_j x A_ijk and alpha(N_i x B_ijk) = N_j x B_ijk, so they glue to a kappa-generated quasi-coherent submodule with the cocycle condition; the poset of such submodules is directed since sums are kappa-generated, and every section lands in one, so F is the directed colimit (source lines 3379-3483)
